There was a '''spaceport''' in the forests of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] that was owned by [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rogoe/Legends|Rogoe]]. It was [[Battle of the Forest Cities|destroyed]] in [[3000 BBY]] by Boss [[Gallo/Legends|Gallo]].
